verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly claim it can implement entirely new features end-to-end from tickets, with its own terminal/IDE/browser tooling, but the pack lacks explicit documentation of writing tests as part of that workflow, and community evidence (HN threads) shows skepticism and real-world limitations (e.g., only 13.8% issue resolution rate, demos not fully meeting requirements, imperfect fixes like wrapping errors in try-catch). missing for 10: explicit first-party or independent evidence of Devin writing tests alongside feature implementation, and stronger hands-on success-rate data.
